A functional plate needs those measurements, and the camera screw should remain metal.","questions":[{"text":"Did the bolt head fit loosely and seat flat in the coupon, and did the shank slide through freely?","answer":null},{"text":"What are the clamp bottom and top gaps at one knob setting, lip height, usable jaw length, stop locations, and tripod model?","answer":null},{"text":"What are the camera weight including lens, usable socket depth, and bolt drive?","answer":null}],"params":{"bolt_head_d":{"value":15,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"Previously reported approximate head width; round recess checks envelope only."},"bolt_head_h":{"value":5,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"Previously reported approximate head height."},"bolt_underhead_length":{"value":10,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"Previously reported approximate length; not validated for camera engagement."},"bolt_nominal_d":{"value":6.35,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"Nominal major diameter of the salvaged 1/4-20 bolt."},"head_radial_clearance":{"value":0.5,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"shank_diametral_clearance":{"value":0.45,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"head_depth_allowance":{"value":0.5,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_floor":{"value":3,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_outer_d":{"value":28,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"bolt_fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"def build(p):
    h = p.coupon_floor + p.bolt_head_h + p.head_depth_allowance
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_outer_d/2).extrude(h)
    bore = cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_nominal_d+p.shank_diametral_clearance)/2).extrude(h)
    pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.coupon_floor).circle(p.bolt_head_d/2+p.head_radial_clearance).extrude(p.bolt_head_h+p.head_depth_allowance)
    return body.cut(bore).cut(pocket)
